decisions.why: The docket is captioned for a 'Kibbe Non-Enforcement Decision', i.e. a municipal officer's decision declining to enforce, styled in parallel with the companion 'Kibbe Building Permit' appeal by the same neighbor-appellant, with the Town a party only to interpret its ordinances. A non-enforcement decision cannot be an enforcement action the town brought, so the only way it reaches the Environmental Court is as an appeal of that municipal decision; the guide counts appeals of municipal enforcement decisions as municipal appeals. The listing information (which lists only 173-8-07 Vtec) adds nothing either way, and the order says nothing contradicting an appeal, so 'unknown' understates what the caption establishes.
